records.title: TechDocs - Documentation as catalog entities
records.description:
Currently, you can ingest markdown documents into Port by creating markdown properties. Each document will be displayed in Port as a tab on the specific entity page.

We would like to add the ability to create a "documentation tree" for each entity, allowing you to create a full wiki inside your developer portal.

Similar to the singular markdown documents, the documents in the "documentation tree" will be searchable via the [global search](https://roadmap.getport.io/ideas/p/global-search).
records.relevance_reason: This is about catalog entity documentation/wiki features, not about configuring, running, approving or debugging self-service Actions.
records.short_summary: The request is for a documentation/wiki tree feature attached to catalog entities, unrelated to self-service actions.
records.user_need: Users want to organize and search documentation associated with catalog entities.
records.suggested_product_action: Add a documentation tree feature for catalog entities with global search support.
records.evidence_excerpt: allowing you to create a full wiki inside your developer portal

records.title: Categorizing Self Service actions
records.description: Allow categorizing self service actions for ease of finding appropriate actions for your needs.
records.relevance_reason: This concerns organizing self-service actions to help users find the right one, which is a core part of Action discovery and organization.
records.short_summary: Users cannot categorize self-service actions, making it harder to find the right action among many.
records.user_need: Users need a way to group and organize actions so they can quickly locate the ones relevant to their task.
records.suggested_product_action: Add support for categorizing and grouping self-service actions to improve discoverability
records.evidence_excerpt: Allow categorizing self service actions for ease of finding appropriate actions for your needs.

records.title: Multi-step workflows
records.description: Chain multiple inputs, approvals, conditions, and actions via automatic triggers or self-service
records.relevance_reason: This describes chaining multiple inputs, approvals, conditions and actions within self-service Actions, which is core Action orchestration functionality.
records.short_summary: Users want to combine multiple steps, approvals and conditions into a single automated action workflow.
records.user_need: The ability to build one action that sequences multiple inputs, approvals and conditional logic together.
records.suggested_product_action: Enable multi-step action workflows that chain inputs, conditions and approvals in a single self-service action.
records.evidence_excerpt: Chain multiple inputs, approvals, conditions, and actions via automatic triggers or self-service
